cards.card_text: Now all the Israelites, from Dan to Beersheba and from the land of Gilead, gather as one man before the LORD at Mizpah.
cards.verse_text: Then all the Israelites from Dan to Beersheba and from the land of Gilead came out, and the congregation assembled as one man before the LORD at Mizpah. The leaders of all the people and all the tribes of Israel presented themselves in the assembly of God’s people: 400,000 men on foot, armed with swords.

cards.card_text: All Israel from Dan to Beersheba knows Samuel is confirmed as a ___ of the LORD.
cards.verse_text: So all Israel from Dan to Beersheba knew that Samuel was confirmed as a prophet of the LORD.

cards.card_text: So Hushai's plan is to gather all Israel from Dan to Beersheba, a multitude like the sand on the seashore.
cards.verse_text: Instead, I advise that all Israel from Dan to Beersheba—a multitude like the sand on the seashore—be gathered to you, and that you yourself lead them into battle.
